name: Scan Offset Computation
definition: Recomputes the scan_offsets array for a classified volume. Each ScanOffset entry stores the first length offset and first data offset for a specific scanline (j, k plane).
summary: Scan Offset Computation generates a lookup table mapping 2D scanline coordinates to starting positions in a 1D RLE data stream, enabling efficient ray traversal by storing only scanline start offsets rather than individual voxel positions.
